meta.note: Auto-generated by taste analysis. Custom clusters are checked first by classify_quip().

clusters.description: Quips that commit to a specific, confident, and slightly provocative opinion or prediction — stated as if it were obvious, often as a challenge or declaration rather than an observation. Distinct from general_wit in that the quip takes a clear side rather than commenting from a distance. Distinct from sports in that it applies across categories.
evidence_quips: Toy Story 5 > The Odyssey
if Toy Story 5 doesn't clinch I'm going on hunger strike
name a bigger company that exists out of pure spite
if geopolitics was Catan, this is like blocking longest road with a port

clusters.description: Quips that apply sports logic/analogies to non-sports bets, or elevate sports bets with vivid play-by-play framing

like watching a 5' 2" middle-schooler sink a deep 3 at the buzzer
this is like if John Harbaugh tweeted a starting line up for OKC

clusters.description: Quips that reference the bet's actual payout amount or market mechanics as the punchline
